  it("widgets.parts.create: POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/widgets/{widget_id}/parts", async () => {
    const { fetch, fixture } = setup();
    const result = await fixture.widgets.parts.create("widget-id-1", { label: "Bolt", sku: "B-100" });
    expect(result).toBeDefined();
    const call = fetch.calls[0]!;
    expect(call.operation).toBe("widgets.parts.create");
    expect(call.method).toBe("POST");
    expect(call.url.pathname).toBe("/v1/workspaces/9b2f6c1e-0d6a-4a63-9a43-2f1c3e4d5a6b/widgets/widget-id-1/parts");
    expect([...call.url.searchParams].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]) || a[1].localeCompare(b[1]))).toEqual([]);
    expect(call.headers.has("idempotency-key")).toBe(true);
    expect(call.headers.has("authorization")).toBe(true);
    expect(call.body).toEqual({ label: "Bolt", sku: "B-100" });
  });
  it("widgets.parts.delete: DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/widgets/{widget_id}/parts/{part_id}", async () => {
    const { fetch, fixture } = setup();
    const result = await fixture.widgets.parts.delete("widget-id-1", "part-id-2");
    expect(result).toBeUndefined();
    const call = fetch.calls[0]!;
    expect(call.operation).toBe("widgets.parts.delete");
    expect(call.method).toBe("DELETE");
    expect(call.url.pathname).toBe("/v1/workspaces/9b2f6c1e-0d6a-4a63-9a43-2f1c3e4d5a6b/widgets/widget-id-1/parts/part-id-2");
    expect([...call.url.searchParams].sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]) || a[1].localeCompare(b[1]))).toEqual([]);
    expect(call.headers.has("idempotency-key")).toBe(false);
    expect(call.headers.has("authorization")).toBe(true);
  });
});
